reviews.text: Today was my first time taking my pup to For My Dogs and it was a great experience. Scheduling the appt was easy, the day of was smooth, I really appreciated the text updates and this little guy is squeaky clean. The best part was picking him up and seeing this cool bandana on him and you can instantly tell he was properly groomed. I will absolutely be back!

Ryan is so caring, welcoming, and friendly! My dog is not fond of getting any kind of bath and hates getting her nails cut. She has epilepsy so overexcitement or anxiety can trigger a seizure. However, Ryan does a phenomenal job of taking care of my fur baby and making sure she’s as calm as possible. It’s also great that he only does one dog at a time so there are no other dogs in the facility during her session. Facility is clean and spacious. I very much appreciate that he doesn’t use a crate at all but has a cute little gated area with a bed and pillows if another client comes in with their dog before I can pick her up. Location is great and very convenient for me. I love the sweet little scarves he gifts her after every session! Such a nice personal touch! Highly recommend!

P.S. @lebuseastfalls - I usually grab a quick bite to eat at Le Bus while waiting to pick up my pup so Le Bus East Falls, you have Ryan to thank for more getting more local business! 😊

Couldn’t be happier with the service here! Ryan is an excellent groomer and our pup Moose always comes home looking amazing! We’ve had skin sensitivity issues in the past that have landed our dog on antibiotics after grooms in the past but Ryan has been incredible about working with our dog’s specific needs and we haven’t had one vet visit since switching here.
Ryan always does amazing with Rascal’s groom! He is so caring and attentive. I highly recommend him to anyone who needs a new groomer for this area :)

Ryan is great overall! He gives 1-1 undivided attention to your dog. Our second time here since moving to East Falls area. My dog isn’t a big fan of the groomers, but she’s the most cooperative with him. The space is just for them at your scheduled time which lessens the stress and allows them to be their best. Good quality, attention to detail and works with you to make you and your dog feel great! You’re in great hands here with Ryan.

I love the space and that my dogs are there without any other dogs. The personalized attention is truly hard to find. The service is amazing and Ryan is such a nice person to interact with. I really enjoyed receiving feedback upon pickup about how my dogs did and it reassured me the interaction went well! My boys seemed very happy.

Love this place. I was going somewhere much further and it was such a blessing to find this place. Ryan is a joy to work with. My lil dog loves the 1:1 attention and the overall service is worth the price.

Ryan does an amazing job at grooming and creating a safe space for anxious and non-anxious dogs alike. He has such great attention to detail and I’m not sure if our pup has ever been happier leaving the groomer. Thank you to Philaqueens for this rec!

We had the best experience at For My Dogs! The space was very clean, and the one-on-one care made such a difference. Riley normally hates the groomer, but she had absolutely no reason to be stressed here. Ryan took so much time to consult with me about her cut, and when I came to pick her up, she was happy and clearly so comfortable. She looks the best she ever has!
Highly recommended. Ryan is a really nice guy, was great with my dog and gave her an excellent full groom.

It is a small owned business ...lovely couple...the facility is clean and well equipped owner is great my dog was very comfortable you could see and feel the genuine care/concern for both pet and owner. Would highly recommend this facility.

I cannot begin to express how grateful I am to have found Ryan and his grooming business! My pup can be a bit of a handful and even with full transparency, Ryan accepted the challenge head on. He makes a concerted effort to play with your dog and make sure they feel comfortable before even attempting to begin grooming. He won my dog over immediately. His patience and insistence of putting the dog and their experience first is unmatched. I would recommend his services as far and above any other salon that we have been to. THANK YOU, RYAN!!!
Absolutely amazing service, my dog was so clean and the groomer was so friendly to my dog. I just moved to the area and I will definitely be a regular. Thank you.

My 2 year old Shih Tzu is very grooming phobic and Ryan was willing to try, to go at his pace, and work toward the long term goal of helping him be okay with grooming. Ryan is very dog centered, knew when Jax was at his limit and not to push… again all about helping Jax in the long run and not the groom yet. When I arrived they were sitting in a chair with Ryan holding scissors and talking to him. Sweet!
Very nice environment as well… super cute vintage building and set up adorably. Highly recommend!!

IF I COULD, I WOULD GIVE  FOR MY DOGS A 10 STAR RATING! RYAN IS PLEASANT, EXCEPTIONAL, REMARKABLE YOUNGMAN AND A OUTSTANDING GROOMER!! HE GOES ABOVE AND BEYOND IN MAKING YOUR PET FEEL RELAXED 😌 AND COMFORTABLE!. THE ATMOSPHER IS WELCOMING AND THE CUSTOMER SERVICE IS OUTSTANDING! THIS WERE OUR FIRST VISIT AND CAN ASSURE IT WILL NOT BE OUR LAST.  ANYONE WITH A FUR BABY AND IS IN NEED OF A GROOMER, PLEASE GIVE FOR DOGS A TRY! YOU AND YOU FIUR BABY WILL NOT WALK AWAY DISAPPOINTED!!

Ryan is a super star! He cut my Pomeranian’s coat today for the first time and it went amazing. We started with a thorough consultation where he considered my wants in addition to adding his amazing expertise. My dog has never felt so soft and looked so good with his new cut! His coat is shining! Ryan was so sweet and playful with Onyx as well. He gave us a grooming schedule and we cannot wait to come back! 10000/10 recommend.
Ryan did a great job grooming our Australian Shepherds, and our dogs loved him.
Ryan took such good care of our girl Maya. She has alot of sores and he was careful with her grooming and took alot of time and attention to her! Highly recommend him to anyone looking for a grooming

Ryan was AMAZING with my high energy working line GSD. My dog is a good girl, but can be anxious at times, especially in places with lots of other dog scents. Echo’s breed can often put groomers on alert as GSDs don’t always like being groomed and have an intimidating look!

Ryan was so easy going, he let me come in to see the spot, let echo roam to get familiarized and offered her some treats and love before any grooming. He fostered the trust between them first and foremost. The location was clean and lovely. It was also nice to know that he would take one dog at a time.

When I picked her up she was fluffy and clean and was on the floor playing with Ryan.
She has been prancing since we left the shop and clearly had a wonderful experience and felt safe and cared for the whole time!

Ryan must really be a dog lover and it’s nice to know for my dogs! It’s really all an owner can ask for! We will DEFINITELY be back! Thank you Ryan!!
Ryan is great! I was nervous about taking my blind chihuahua for his first groom but Ryan let me stay and watch the whole time! He was very patient with ollie and he looks and feels great!
Did an amazing job with my dog who very much needed a clean up.
Phenomenal job my Sheba Friday gets quite nervous when it comes to grooming sessions, but she had a great time here and came out so fresh and clean definitely will bring her back

Until I stumbled upon Ryan’s small business in East Falls, grooming visits for my pups felt just like vet visits—and those never seem to go well...Ryan greets my dogs in the same warm, welcoming manner he shows their owners. After my fourth visit to For My Dogs Grooming & Hygiene this morning, young Ellie and Oscar were more excited to see Ryan in his shop than they were to see me when I came to pick them up! Ryan does a great job and I will gladly continue to support this growing small business.
Ryan took care of my family's baby girl Ginger. Excellent service and results. Absolutely the best grooming salon in East Falls.

For My Dogs is the BEST! And Ryan the owner is AWESOME! I recently took my baby Jewels here to get groomed. Not only was this a great experience for Jewels, I had a great time as well. LOL! This place is BEAUTIFUL, VERY CLEAN, RELAXING and definitely NOT like any other grooming business I have ever been to. The decor is gorgeous. I cannot say enough good things about this place.

But back to Jewels, who is a slightly older dog (still my baby nonetheless), does not really enjoy getting groomed anymore. Ryan did an amazing job making her feel comfortable. It was as if he had groomed Jewels, her whole life. He took his time with her and honored my requests on how I would like for her to be groomed. I was so appreciative of this. The one-on-one grooming experience truly helps and I know Jewels greatly appreciated this. :) Jewels looked beautiful and she knew it!

I did not leave without making my next appointment and we are looking forward to it. This place is truly a "Gem" and WE are so happy we found it. :)

I have never been able to get my corgi groomed until now. Ryan’s place is extremely unique - he focuses on one dog at a time and makes sure the experience is as painless as possible. The experience is truly built for the convenience for your dog. Will definitely be back.

Ryan takes care of your dog like it’s his own child- my puppy is very hard to groom yet he made him so comfortable and happy ( and handsomely groomed !). When I picked my dog up, he was sleeping on Ryan’s lap on the couch, instead of leaving him in a holding pen. If you want a groomer who is kind , trustworthy and passionate about his work, this is your guy.
I highly recommend using For My Dogs, you can not do any better.

“Thank you for the exceptional grooming services provided for my dog, Chef. I truly appreciate the professionalism, attention to detail, and care you showed throughout the process. Chef looks fantastic and was clearly well taken care of. I look forward to bringing him back in the future.”

After hearing about this new spot, I took my sweet Millie to see Ryan. Millie and I were both thoroughly impressed by the experience. The shop itself is beautiful and obviously designed with client comfort in mind. The vibe was so tranquil I almost signed myself up for a groom. Ryan was accommodating, professional, and expertly handled Millie’s nerves. He did a great job of keeping Millie calm and safe, all while leaving her fresh and fluffy enough to trot around the ring at Westminster. It’s Ryan’s caring touch and kindness that sets this place apart. What a great addition to the East Falls small business community! We will certainly be back.

Ryan and Maria were so gentle and caring during grooming for our dog’s first groom.  She was so scared but they were calming and attentive to her every need.  We will definitely be back.  Highly recommend!!

This man is a saint! Ryan is the sweetest, coolest, most professional man everrrr!! My "son" gets a little nervous when groomed and he doesn't usually like men foR some reason.  He INSTANTLY fell in love with Ryan. He gave Ryan all the snuggles, hugs and kisses. The finished result was absolutely perfect! Ryan puts so much love into his work. He is truly the dog whisperer. My "son" was so calm and relaxed with Ryan. The most adorable scene was Ryan cuddling and holding him when I came to pick him up.  This man is amazing and his work is STELLAR. I am a customer for life!! Ryan also took time to meet my "daughter".  We scheduled her asap!! She couldn't stop giving him kisses. 10 out of 10 and highly recommend.

I recently took my two dogs (border collie and golden retriever) to For My Dogs. I was nervous about trying a new groomer but Ryan did an amazing job! Both dogs looked great! And smelled amazing for a whole week. The place is very welcoming and they don’t use crates instead they have a small holding area with comfy beds!

I'm absolutely thrilled with the dog grooming service here! I brought my dog Maude, in for a much-needed grooming. Ryan is incredibly friendly, professional, and clearly has a real love for animals. If you're looking for a reliable, high-quality groomer who will treat your pet with care and kindness, this is the place to go.

Took my dog Oakley to For My Dogs, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience! The team was so welcoming and gentle with him—he can be a little nervous, but they put him right at ease. He came out looking like a super star, super clean, and smelling amazing. You can tell they really care about the dogs they work with. I’m so glad we found a groomer we can trust. Highly recommend them if you want your pup treated like family!

Ryan did an awesome job with our border collie who can be a real handful! Low stress environment made her feel relaxed and comfortable. Ran into Ry and his own dog at the park a few weeks later and he remembered us right away and wanted to again make sure we were happy with everything. Will definitely be going back to support this local business!

My dog is typically petrified of going to the groomer. The owner did a spectacular job of making her feel comfortable prior to starting the grooming process. My dog was happy and looked and smelled wonderful afterward. I’ll be back regularly!
Ryan did an amazing job with my little poodle Milli! The space is welcoming and very low-stress for pups. You can tell that he puts love into every groom. He’s earned a lifetime client in us!

To start, I will tell ya I love my dog Mr. Bear, he is a part of my family. So, finding someone who treats him with the same care  I do is very important to me. And I've got to say, my recent experience with For My Dogs Grooming & Hygiene
was truly exceptional.

From the moment I walked in, you could tell this wasn't just a business; it was a place where they genuinely love animals. They were warm, professional, and took the time to really connect with Mr. Bear, making him feel comfortable and at ease.

What impressed me most was the clear communication. They kept me updated throughout the whole process, letting me know how my dog was doing and when I could expect him to be ready. It's that kind of attention to detail that makes all the difference.

And the results? Well, let me tell ya, my dog looked fantastic! A fresh cut and smelled amazing. He looked like a million bucks!

In my opinion, It's clear that For My Dogs Grooming & Hygiene
goes above and beyond, and I will be back! They've earned my trust for sure. That's the kind of service that deserves the highest praise. A great experience, all around."

We've struggled with finding a groomer who was competent, professional, caring, and priced fairly. Ryan is exceptional in all of the above. We were really glad to discover his business and highly recommend!
Excellent service! My Scottish Terrier came out looking regal, and my older dog who doesn't like to have her nails cut was totally at ease after a bath!
Ryan did a great job with my dog, Jack.  Jack turned out great and we will be back for sure!
Rusty looked awesome, smelled great and had a wonderful experience!

I highly recommend  "for my Dogs" Dog grooming in East Falls.
I have a large Airedale who does not do well with other dogs or being in a crate. This place was perfect. Ryan only has once dog at a time and doesn't use crates.  She loved being there, Ryan gave her lots of attention  and  she looks beautiful.
Ryan did a fantastic job grooming my dog Bax! He really shows he genuinely cares about all of the dogs! Check out the huge difference in these before and after photos!!

We recently had the ‘For My Dogs’ grooming experience. It was awesome! Ryan was warm and welcoming, instantly making both me and my furry friend feel at ease. He took the time to understand my dog's grooming needs and preferences, ensuring a personalized touch.

The grooming itself was spectacular! Ryan transformed my dog’s double coat, leaving it looking clean, shiny, and ready for spring. He was gentle and patient throughout the process, which is super important for my anxious pup. The attention to detail was impressive, and it was clear that Ryan has a true passion for his work.

I highly recommend ‘For My Dogs Grooming & Hygiene’, especially if you're looking for someone who genuinely cares about the well-being of your pet. Thank you, Ryan, for the fantastic job! We’ll definitely be back!
Ryan did a great job with our dog Nellie he was very caring with her and did a excellent job
